info.longName: Amplify SILJ Junior Silver Miners Covered Call ETF

funds_data.description: The manager will achieve junior silver mining company investment exposure through investments in a selection of equity securities held by the Amplify Junior Silver Miners ETF. In addition, the fund will invest in financial instruments that provide exposure to exchange products (“Silver ETPs”) designed to track the price return of silver (i.e., “spot” silver prices) (the “Silver Price”). The fund is non-diversified.
